question.text: Surya Energy AIF (Cat I, 7-yr tenure): Set-up costs = INR 3 crore, PPM specifies amortisation over the FIRST 36 MONTHS (3 years) instead of full fund tenure. What is the annual set-up cost charged in each of Years 1, 2, and 3?

answer.text: INR 1.00 crore per year for 3 years (then zero)
INR 0.4286 crore per year for 7 years
INR 0.30 crore per year for 10 years

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 6 allows amortisation over 36 months or fund life. If 36-month elected: INR 3 cr / 3 yr = INR 1 crore per year, charged in Years 1-3; zero thereafter. **The Trap:** B is full-tenure amortisation (INR 3/7 = 0.4286); C is no amortisation (one-shot); D is arbitrary. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests. The shorter amortisation accelerates P&L hit but may be preferred in some fund structures for faster cost-recovery reporting. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Under 36-month amortisation, early LPs see higher expense drag. Under full-tenure, it smooths but is economically similar. Choose based on LP sophistication: retail-heavy funds prefer smoothed (full-tenure); institutional LPs often prefer transparent 36-month hit and cleaner post-3-year expense ratio.
